episodes.synopsis: The Sasazuka MgRonald's remodeling is complete. New toilets! Better coffee machines! Maou and Ashiya's worries would be over, if it weren't for the girls' suspicious new habit.
episodes.title: The Devil Returns to the Workplace

episodes.synopsis: The battle with Gabriel and Raguel is over, but the transition back into daily life isn't all smooth sailing.
episodes.title: The Devil and the Hero Question Their Daily Routine

episodes.synopsis: Maou has been thinking about dreams ever since his conversation with Kisaki, and he knows exactly what to do next. Of course, whether he can get the necessary parties' buy-in on his dream is another matter...
episodes.title: The Devil and the Hero Take the First Steps toward a New Dream

episodes.synopsis: Alas Ramus deserves a safe and comfy place to sleep! Emi and Maou go on a futon-shopping quest while Ashiya and Urushihara try to figure out what's going on with Suzuno.
episodes.title: The Devil and the Hero Go Futon Shopping

episodes.synopsis: Emi takes a trip to Ente Isla. Those left behind in Japan spend a lot of time arguing about whether or not they're worried.
episodes.title: The Hero Says Goodbye for a Time

episodes.synopsis: Urushihara and Suzuno rush to Chiho's aid, but Maou lags behind thanks to his lack of magic and his confusing new acquaintances. Meanwhile, Ashiya has the toughest job of all: explaining all this to Rika.
episodes.title: The Devil Gets Off to a Late Start

episodes.synopsis: Who's holding Emi hostage? Why are so many humans, demons, and angels after Ashiya? Maou needs to find out all this and more, but first he needs a new source of power to defeat the invading army with.
episodes.title: The Hero Weeps

episodes.synopsis: Emi is freshly struck by all the differences between Ente Isla and Japan. Then Alas Ramus reveals more about herself, causing Emi to reevaluate several things. Meanwhile, Maou is just trying to coexist with Acieth Alla without losing his mind.
episodes.title: The Hero Questions Her Hometown

episodes.synopsis: Maou and Suzuno make their way through Ente Isla's forests. Emi and Ashiya each learn what they've been brought to Efzahan for.
episodes.title: The Devil Vomits

episodes.synopsis: Are we about to finally learn the landlady's secret?! Also, Ashiya takes control of the Malebranche while Maou struggles with his magic and Emi struggles with the stress of her position.
episodes.title: The Devil Loses His Standing

episodes.synopsis: Suzuno and Albert's plan hits a snag, but Emi and Ashiya's plans are going oddly well. The big questions of the day are: Can Maou merge with Acieth again? And does he have enough gas left in Powered Dullahan III?
episodes.title: The Hero Dances on the Battlefield

episodes.synopsis: At last, all the players are in place for the final battle in Efzahan. What happens next?
episodes.title: The Devil and the Hero Witness Change in Ente Isla
